name: The Bride Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals the intimate and sacred relationship between Christ and His church through the metaphor of marriage, portraying God as the faithful husband and the church as His bride. Isaiah highlights God's role as the covenant husband who rejoices over His people, while Ephesians emphasizes Christ's sacrificial love in giving Himself for the church to present her holy and blameless. The New Testament further illustrates this union with the imagery of the bridegroom and bride, culminating in the eschatological celebration of the Lamb's marriage, where the bride is made ready and glorified.
